headline: Edu dept sends back BSUSC 'recommendation' for minister's appointment as Asst Professor | Hindustan Times
description: Rural works minister Ashok Chaudhary was recommended by BSUSC to join Pataliputra University as Asst Prof of Political Science, but now the Bihar education department has sent back recommendation for his appointment for 'review', triggering speculation that there are fears of legal trouble for the minister
